blocks.text: Downloading and Installing a Voice Library

inline.s: 1. In the lower part of the 'Langdunü' interface (see the figure below), click 'Download Voice' to enter the download page. Or, visit the download page directly (its URL is:
2. After entering the voice library download page,
. First, preview the pronunciation of the speaker;
. If you like it, click the download link to download it (as shown below).
3. After entering the relevant cloud-disk address, simply click to download (see the figure below):
After downloading the voice library (speaker), follow the usage instructions in the file package to install the voice library.
Right-click the downloaded compressed file (for example, '
), and choose which folder to extract it to. (Note: the names of this folder and all folders above it must be in English, otherwise it will not work properly!)
Enter the voice library folder you just extracted and double-click 'Start and Stop Voice Service Program

Note: some antivirus software may mistakenly report 'Start and Stop Voice Service Program' as a virus. If it is removed as a virus by your antivirus software, please recover the file, mark it as trusted, and then run it.
Click 'Start Voice Service,' and the following dialog box will appear; select 'Yes.'
Then another dialog box will appear; select 'OK' to complete the installation of the voice library.
After installing the voice library, restart 'Langdunü,' click 'Speaker,' and after the 'Speaker' list appears, click the speaker you just installed, and you can use it to read text aloud.
